description: Store-first preload plan (docs/message-sync.md#store-first-preload). `rooms` are the preload targets not already cached, in order; `tokens` the rooms a live REQ carrying them had reached EOSE for when the pass checked; `certain` the rooms the store answered as certain. The plan: `check` = rooms asked of the store (those with a token), `certain` = rooms not requested and left for an open to draw from the store, `fetch` = rooms requested from the relay in one batch, `no_token` = the fetched rooms that had no token (not checked). Desktop: desktop/src/features/messages/lib/storePreloadPlan.ts; mobile: mobile/lib/features/channels/store_preload_plan.dart.

cases.name: rooms without a token are fetched without a store check
a certain answer for a room without a token does not count
a certain answer for a room not asked about does not count
a repeated room is planned once, where it first appears
nothing is fetched when every room is certain
